usage.desc: Showing progress through a known sequence. It only displays state — Wizard is the one that navigates.
`horizontal` for three or four short steps; `vertical` when the labels are long.
A check by default; `number` when the step number is what people refer to.
Makes each step tappable. Only wire it if going back is actually allowed.

completedIndicator.description: What the circle of a completed step shows: a check, or its number.

current.description: Index of the current step (0-based). Earlier ones are marked 'completed'.

onStepPress.description: If passed, every step becomes tappable and reports its index.
